notes.subject: ⟨Yawe⟩
notes.rationale: לפניו is only 'before his face'; the one walking is unnamed — Bambara needs the name supplied.

notes.subject: לדרך פעמיו
notes.rationale: KJV reads 'set us in the way of his steps' (supplying 'us'); JPS/ASV read 'make his footsteps a way' — the Bambara follows the literal 'puts his footsteps as a way'.

notes.subject: to the community
notes.rationale: The psalm's closing vision is spoken over the people, righteousness preparing the way before God's coming.

translation: Kɛnɛya bɛ taa ⟨Yawe⟩ ɲɛfɛ, ka a ka bogow da sira ye.
